title: 上海高考翻译背诵-70-25一模

items.zh: 房间里堆满了主人从世界各地收来的古董。
items.en: The room is filled with antiques collected by the owner from across the world.

items.zh: 与人相处时，我们要学会换位思考并体谅他人的难处。
items.en: When getting along with others, we should learn to put ourselves in others’ shoes and be considerate of their difficulties.

items.zh: 尽管加速通过黄灯能省点时间，但这种行为很可能引发严重的交通事故。
items.en: While rushing through the yellow light can save a little time, this behavior is highly likely to lead to serious traffic accidents.

items.zh: 这场演唱会的舞台设计以创新和高科技元素面闻名,给观众带来无与伦比的视听感受。
items.en: Famous for its innovation and high-tech elements, the stage design of the concert provided the audience with an unparalleled audio-visual experience.
